description: NFIP Standard Flood Insurance Policy forms as published in 44 CFR Part 61.

extraction.output_format: UTF-8 plain text, LF line endings
rules: Block elements HEAD/HD1-HD4/P/FP/CITA become paragraphs in document order.
Headings are prefixed with '## ' to preserve the form's own structure.
Runs of whitespace inside a block collapse to a single space; the XML wraps lines for transport and that wrapping is not part of the regulation.
Blocks are joined with a blank line; the file ends with a newline.
No text is paraphrased, reordered, summarised, or otherwise altered.
